column1: # runtime  : nvptxrt.dll (source-built; no CUDA runtime linked)
# Set: 792 test targets declared under //max/kernels/test/gpu/..., of which 279
# minus 11 manual-tagged and the manual fuzz package = 251.
# The --local_resources flags are NOT optional. GPU targets declare
# exec_properties test.resources:gpu-memory, which Bazel's local resource
# manager does not know; without them every GPU test is refused with
# "Resource gpu-memory is not being tracked" and REPORTED AS A BUILD FAILURE.
# That mislabel is why 218 of 251 targets looked broken before this flag.
